This post compares renting platforms you don’t control to owning infrastructure nobody can revoke.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy rent you access to payment processing, product hosting, and delivery. They own the infrastructure, dictate the terms, and can revoke access at will. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, deploys tools you own: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. Full data ownership. One option rents convenience. The other builds permanence.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude entire regions based on financial compliance policies. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy follow suit, relying on these payment processors. If your country is on the blacklist, you’re locked out. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this entirely. It uses open-source tools and on-chain crypto payments that operate without geographic restrictions. No compliance officer can shut it down. No algorithm flags your location. It’s commerce infrastructure built for the 149 countries Stripe ignores.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms charge 2.9% to 5% per transaction, plus monthly fees for advanced features. PayPal holds funds for weeks. Stripe’s payouts are delayed in restricted regions. Sovereign stacks use NOWPayments with a flat 0.5% fee for 300+ cryptocurrencies. Transactions confirm on-chain in minutes. No KYC. No buyer account required. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10 per transaction. The real cost? Platforms extract rent. Infrastructure is a one-time investment.
Platforms rent you access. Infrastructure gives you ownership.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your customer data, product files, and transaction history. They can suspend your account or change terms overnight. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership. Cloudflare Workers automate order processing. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly after payment. Supabase stores orders securely. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access. You own the stack. You control the data. Automation runs on your rules—not a platform’s algorithm.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This stack bypasses geographic restrictions, gives you full data ownership, and processes payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure that operates without platform dependency.
NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee—no KYC required.

If you’re in a restricted country, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this infrastructure in 48 hours. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration, with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to deploy. For those who prefer to build manually, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation and source code.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.

PayPal operates in limited capacities in these countries, often without full withdrawal options. Account suspensions can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. For sovereign commerce, use NOWPayments with cryptocurrencies like USDT on BSC for instant, low-fee transactions.

What networks have the lowest transaction fees for NOWPayments?
Use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks for fees under $0.10 per transaction. Avoid Ethereum for high gas fees. USDT on BSC is recommended for stability and low cost.
